statement: The pinned xpadneo probe sets HID_QUIRK_INPUT_PER_APP and may construct separate gamepad, keyboard, consumer-control and mouse Linux input devices. It creates synthetic fallback nodes when the descriptor did not supply the application, copying the post-normalization HID bus and product identity. A single HID-level controller may therefore produce several evdev nodes rather than the single xpad-like gamepad evdev object.
